In the meantime, if you can send a photo of the machine and any error code, that would help.

arguments.decision_needed: The LG washing machine that was in the flat at the start of the tenancy has reportedly failed (power failure, tenant says unrepairable). Is it a landlord-supplied appliance? Tenant offers to buy a replacement at their own cost, keep it as their property and take it when they leave. Do you agree, or would you rather repair/replace it yourself?
options: Agree: tenant replaces at own cost, remains tenant's property, removed at end of tenancy (recommended if the machine is yours and you don't want to fund a replacement)
Landlord arranges a contractor to inspect/repair or replace it

arguments.body: Thanks for letting us know about the washing machine, and for offering to replace it. Please hold off buying one for now: as the machine was in the flat when you moved in, we need to check with your landlord first, including that the new one would stay yours and could be taken with you when you leave. We've asked them and will come back to you once we hear. This is a routine job, so we aim to have it moving within 14 days. In the meantime, if you can send a photo of the machine and any error code, that would help.
